author: Bloomberg
title: China boosts domestic demand with $9 billion consumer subsidy plan
description: China plans to spend nearly $9 billion on consumer goods trade-in subsidies next year, funding the move via sovereign bonds to revive domestic demand.
content: China will provide nearly $9 billion to subsidize its consumer goods trade-in drive next year, extending a stimulus program aimed at shoring up domestic demand and countering external headwinds faced… [+1120 chars]
